schematic_notes: PRELIMINARY - R2 BLOCKED - NOT FOR FABRICATION. Values marked DATASHEET / ASSUMED in properties; calculations in Gate1d/Gate2 evidence.
POWER: Q301 drain=raw; Q302 drain=protected; common sources=PROT_MID=LTC7001 TS. No bypass. Eight raw bulk capacitors are UPSTREAM.
CROWBAR: protected -> (R308+R309)||(R310+R311) -> Q303 drain; source=GND. Four33mOhm elements give33mOhm. Gate1d pulse conditions apply.
ARM: reset first; wait SUPPLY_OK/reference delay; press ARM. Delayed history latch prevents startup crowbar pulse; RUN requires both latches.
FAULT: OV or loss of BUCK_PGOOD clears run latch; history holds; crowbar and input SHDN assert until RESET. No automatic retry.
OPEN: timing/ringing,125C pulse thermal screen,<=220uF downstream sensitivity,series-FET SOA,inrush/bulk stability,actual harness resistance.
CALCULATED: nominal trip5.325V; fault screen5.4816V (+18.39mV); Pi static5A4.7614V (+11.43mV). Neither margin is physically validated.
CORRECTIONS: drain ballast; common-source pair;2.2Meg gate bleed preserves LTC charge pump;7.5V independent drive; clamp to sinking2.5V reference.
CAPTURE CORRECTIONS: U315 pins1..6=VDD,OUTH,OUTL,GND,IN-,IN+; D303 isolates AUX against negative input; DRV_7V5 nominal7.623V.
DATASHEET packages: DCT latch land; PCH bulk10x16mm; series FET footprints retain pins1..8. All MPN-OPEN passives require procurement review.
ERC source declarations: VIN_AUX via D303; VOUT_PROTECTED via the fitted opposed-FET channels. Flags do not bypass or validate protection.

reconciliation.scope: Preserved83-part capture and two-latch control topology; corrected pin/package assignments; added auxiliary reverse diode/bleed and adjusted driver divider. Alternative78-part latch topology not adopted.
